user.title: Set up ShabBOT
user.description: Zmanim are calculated for Home Assistant's location ({latitude}, {longitude}, {time_zone}). The Israel box starts checked when that country is Israel or the map pin is in Israel. You can change it. ShabBOT starts in dry-run mode: it logs what it would do without touching devices until you turn dry-run off.

data.yom_tov_end_minutes: Yom Tov end: minutes after sunset
data.israel: Israel (Eretz Yisrael: one-day Yom Tov and the Israel Torah reading)

data.yom_tov_end_minutes: Yom Tov end: minutes after sunset
data.israel: Israel (Eretz Yisrael: one-day Yom Tov and the Israel Torah reading)

start_override.name: Start override
start_override.description: Pause device protection for the given devices.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Defaults to each device's setting.

set_slot_routine.name: Choose routine for a meal
set_slot_routine.description: Use a different routine for one night/day only. Leave the routine empty to go back to the default.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Date of the Shabbat/Yom Tov day and part, e.g. 2026-10-10/night.

skip_slot.name: Skip a meal
skip_slot.description: Skip (or un-skip) the routine for one night/day only.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Turn off to restore the routine.

reconcile.name: Reconcile now
reconcile.description: Set every managed device to its scheduled state now.

announce.name: Speak an announcement
announce.description: Speak one sentence on the announcement players now. In dry run, it is only logged. Leave the message empty for a test sentence.

message.name: Message
message.description: What to say. Empty uses a short test sentence.

get_day_info.name: Get the day's Jewish calendar
get_day_info.description: Hebrew date, parasha, Daf Yomi, and zmanim as structured data, plus a short summary. text is that sentence as written. spoken is the TTS respelling. Leave the date empty for right now (the Hebrew date moves at shkia). A date uses that civil day's daytime.

date.name: Date
date.description: Civil date (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty means now, and the Hebrew day begins at shkia.

get_daily_briefing.name: Kids' daily briefing
get_daily_briefing.description: One spoken script for kids: Hebrew date, parasha or holiday, Daf Yomi, shkia, candle lighting or havdalah, a countdown, the weather entity you picked, and a note from home. text is the sentence as written and spoken is the TTS respelling. With no date, the calendar wording stays the same from morning until shkia. The voice module has to be on. Nothing is read from the web.

date.name: Date
date.description: Civil date (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty means right now.
